shared_elements: figures rendered in low relief in strict profile
more than one figure repeated on a single flat panel
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic convention of carving profile figures in shallow relief on a flat stone face, with several figures on one surface. A shows schematic, outline-only quadrupeds/animals stacked vertically down a narrow pillar with no interaction, whereas B shows a horizontal procession of naturalistically detailed, garmented human attendants with beards and caps carrying bowls and handled vessels toward a staff-holding figure — different subject, different relationships, different conventions.
